text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black ran the Japan Cup to the 
very end. The fans erupted in joy, 
chanting "Kitasan! Kitasan!" in unison.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next up at last is the Arima Kinen, run by 
the two of them together. The place they 
had aimed for as one in mind and body.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black charged ahead and set the 
example, with Satono Diamond following 
closely behind. It was precisely because 
of this dynamic that they reached their 
dream stage.
